title: The Hidden Giant Under Oregon
hook: Your boots could be walking across the largest living thing on Earth.
script: Your boots could be walking across the largest living thing on Earth. So why does it look like nothing more than ordinary dirt? Most people still think the blue whale holds that undisputed crown. Under an Oregon forest, a single organism called the honey fungus covers four square miles. Almost all of this giant exists underground as a vast web of threads. The entire woods is its meal. You never walked among individual trees, you were standing on one endless predator.

Four square miles of a single organism hidden right beneath your feet.
The strangest giant on the planet is completely invisible from above.
